description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS driver implementing syscon (system controller) functionality, including register read/write, initialization, and device configuration.

methods.name: syscon_generic_get_base
methods.description: Retrieves the base address of the device's memory-mapped IO region.

methods.name: syscon_generic_read_reg
methods.description: Reads a register value from the device, with size and width considerations.

methods.name: syscon_generic_write_reg
methods.description: Writes a value to a device register, with size and width considerations.

methods.name: syscon_generic_get_size
methods.description: Gets the size of the device's memory region.

methods.name: syscon_generic_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, mapping its MMIO region.
